name: Ravenpost
description: Social media scheduling for AI agents: list the accounts connected in Ravenpost (Instagram, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, YouTube, Pinterest and Telegram), upload media and cut an image to each network's canvas, preview a post as each network will render it with a warning for anything a network would reject, then save it as a draft, schedule it, queue it or publish it; edit or cancel pending posts and read followers and engagement where a network reports them.
author: Ravenpost
